fusions.name: Indenture
fusions.desc: You lunge up to 5 tiles to the target and clamp down on it, dealing 16 damage. The target is 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Snapped Cover
fusions.desc: Slams a great book shut around you, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. The damage ignores armour.

fusions.name: The Fine Print
fusions.desc: Hides a clause at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles takes 22 damage.

fusions.name: Overdue Notice
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your next strike gains 30% critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds.
